idempotencyConstruction: generatedAt is DERIVED FROM the revision (a content constant), not read from the wall clock. A generator that stamps the current time can never produce two byte-identical runs, so byte-identical idempotency is impossible with a clock-derived timestamp; making generatedAt part of the content is the only construction that satisfies 'artifact contains generatedAt' AND 'two runs identical'. Verified in t16 (intermediate) and t18 (final freeze gate).
